audience: Busy male professionals 30–50, $100k+ income, frustrated with weight gain and fading energy. Already tried generic gym memberships, MyFitnessPal, and at least one online coach.
core_pain: Lost the body they had at 25 and can't get it back
Feel 65 at 42 — mentally sharp but physically declining
transformation: Confidence in photos and the mirror
offer: 12-week 1-on-1 coaching — custom training, nutrition built around their schedule, accountability calls 2x per week with the head coach personally.
unique_mechanism: Weekly program rebuilds based on actual data from the previous week (sleep, training, stress) — not a static 12-week PDF. Plus 2 calls/week directly with the head coach, not a junior.
objections: I don't have time for another program
Too expensive — what if it doesn't work?
I've tried other coaches before. They were generic.
I travel a lot for work, this won't fit my schedule
I don't want to track macros or count every calorie

guarantee: 90-day results guarantee — follow the plan, complete the calls, and if you're not down at least 12 lbs at day 90, full refund.
tone: direct, confident, no-fluff, slightly contrarian. Sounds like a coach who's seen it all and isn't going to coddle you.
voice_examples: Most coaches will tell you to count macros. Don't. Most of my clients have never tracked a macro and they got better results.
If you're under 40 and can't squat your bodyweight, that's the first thing we fix.
I don't take everyone. The free strategy call is also my screening — if it's not a fit on either side, I'll tell you.

scarcity.details: Cap at 12 active clients per cohort. Each cohort starts on the 1st of the month.

_notes_for_writer: Awareness level is problem-aware — they know the pain. Use PAS for short copy, PASTOR for long-form.
Tone is direct/contrarian — avoid hype words, exclamation marks, or guru-speak.
Always anchor on the unique mechanism (weekly rebuilds + head coach access). That's the differentiator.
Use Michael R.'s story as the primary case study — he matches the audience profile most closely.
Price reveals upfront. No fake value stacks.
